## Summary
A two-page internal finance memo reporting Q3 2026 results for the Northwind trading desk. Revenue rose 12% quarter over quarter to $4.8M on flat headcount; the memo attributes the gain to the new settlement pipeline and warns that Q4 carries a one-off migration cost.

## Structure
PDF, 2 pages. Headings in order: "Q3 2026 Results", "Revenue", "Costs", "Outlook", "Appendix A: methodology".

## Figures and tables
Table 1 (page 1), "Revenue by desk": Northwind 4.8, Ashgrove 2.1, Kestrel 0.6, all in $M. Figure 1 (page 2) is a line chart of monthly revenue from Jan to Sep 2026, rising from 1.1 to 1.7 with a dip to 0.9 in May.

## Verbatim text
Q3 2026 Results

Revenue
Revenue for the quarter was $4.8M, up 12% from $4.3M in Q2. The increase is attributable almost entirely to the settlement pipeline that went live on 14 July; excluding it, revenue would have been approximately flat.

Costs
Operating costs were $3.1M against $3.0M in Q2. Headcount was unchanged at 41. The largest single line item remains clearing fees at $0.9M.

Outlook
We expect Q4 revenue between $4.9M and $5.2M. Note that the ledger migration scheduled for November carries a one-off cost of approximately $0.4M which is not reflected in the range above.

Appendix A: methodology
Revenue is recognised on settlement date. Figures are unaudited.
